description: Use when the user asks for the drillholes in an area with their downhole paths or gold grades. Give a bbox (west/south/east/north) or a point (lon/lat, with radius_km). Returns holes[], each with collar lon/lat, src (company or openfile) and intervals[{f, t, dip, az, au}] desurveyed from dip and azimuth (company holes carry per-interval Au grade; open-file holes have collar and total depth only), capped for size; plus a mapUrl and view3dUrl, a link to the platform's 3D view of the same area (grades by element, rock log, sections; opens in a browser, no sign-in).

radius_km.description: Point mode: half-size of the square, km (0.5-8).

name: get_drillhole_traces
title: Get drillhole traces
